name: Slate
description: A slate roof laid in staggered courses, each slate lapping the course below with its lower corners clipped, and a band of pointed purple slates every few rows.

code.style: --rule: ( @y(even) { transform: translateX(50%); } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { z-index: @calc(100 - @y); --sh: @match(y % 4 == 0, @var(--sp), @var(--sc)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1.5%; top: 0; width: 97%; height: 124%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color6) 0, transparent 30%), @match(y % 4 == 0, var(--color5), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4))); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--sh); clip-path: @var(--sh); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -98.5%; top: 0; width: @match(x == 1, 97%, 0); height: 124%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color6) 0, transparent 30%), @match(y % 4 == 0, var(--color5), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4))); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--sh); clip-path: @var(--sh); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --sc: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 86%, 86% 100%, 14% 100%, 0% 86%); --sp: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 76%, 50% 100%, 0% 76%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
